name: Shanxi Installation Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanxi Installation Group Co., Ltd. provides contract and energy management services in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It operates through two segments, Construction and Non-Construction Business. The company engages in professional industrial construction and auxiliary construction.
